headings.styles: Elegant, tight tracking for large sizes, classic editorial feel.

body.styles: Clean, highly readable, modern contrast to the serif headings.

labels.styles: Uppercase, wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]), tiny text for overlines and tags.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper grain or noise overlay to give an archival, historic museum feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E5 for cards and grids to provide structured, magazine-like layouts.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle, diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-sm or custom 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)). Avoid heavy dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. For sticky headers or map overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with 1px border-white/40.
visual_enhancers.artistic_elements: Incorporate sketch-style architectural drawings and ink-style illustrations subtly in the background or as section transitions.

layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace. Use py-20, py-24, or py-32 for section padding. Container padding should be px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24.
layouts.grids: Use 'The Swiss Grid' - asymmetrical, content-led layouts. Mix wide hero images with narrow text columns.
layouts.cards: Flat, rectangular, 1px border, no radius (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) for a premium editorial look. Avoid generic rounded SaaS cards.

motion.scrolling: Smooth scrolling using Lenis to give weight and premium feel.
motion.transitions: Slow, elegant fade-ins and slide-ups (duration 0.6s to 1s).
motion.interactions: Hover states on images: slow scale-up (scale-105) with image filter changes (e.g., grayscale to color). Text links underline reveal.

pages.Homepage: Full-screen cinematic hero image with dark overlay (bg-black/30), massive elegant typography (FORTS OF MAHARASHTRA), orange accent search bar. Followed by bento-style animated stats, a carousel of featured forts, and a vertical timeline section.
pages.Fort Directory: Clean grid/list toggle. Left sidebar for detailed filters (district, region, type). Cards should focus on photography with elegant typography underneath. 'Explore More' CTA in Burnt Orange.
pages.Fort Detail: Immersive editorial layout. Massive hero image. Content split into distinct sections: Documented History vs Legends (clearly marked). Include fact cards, timeline, architectural sketches, and a stylized map. Comment section at the bottom.
pages.Interactive Map: Full-width Leaflet/OSM map. Custom Burnt Orange markers. Floating glassmorphic preview cards when clicking markers.
pages.Travel Planner: Interactive itinerary builder. Select forts from a list, drag-and-drop timeline, exportable summary.
pages.Stories: Long-form editorial articles. Narrow reading column (max-w-2xl), large drop caps, pull quotes in Burnt Orange, high-res inline images.
pages.Admin Dashboard: Dense, clean, high-contrast utility layout. Dark Charcoal side nav, white content area. Standard Shadcn tables and forms.

components.buttons: Rectangular, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#E87524] text-white hover:bg-[#cf661d]. Secondary: outline border-[#252525] text-[#252525] hover:bg-[#252525] hover:text-white.
components.inputs: Minimalist. border-b only or very subtle 1px full border. Focus state: border-[#E87524] ring-0.
components.badges: For tags (e.g., 'Legend', 'Fact', 'Hill Fort'): text-xs uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 px-2 py-1.
components.shadcn_overrides: Remove heavy border radii. Adjust focus rings to Burnt Orange.

icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}) to match the elegant editorial styling.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Pure White on Dark Charcoal Grey and vice-versa passes AAA. Burnt Orange should primarily be used for large text or interactive elements (buttons) with White text.
accessibility.aria: Use semantic HTML (article, section, aside, nav). All interactive elements must have aria-labels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='explore-forts-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium editorial digital museum and travel platform. Do NOT use generic SaaS layouts. Rely on HTML/Tailwind for marketing/editorial sections, and use Shadcn only for complex interactives (forms, maps, admin).
Use Playfair Display for all main headings to provide a classic heritage feel.
Inject the 'architectural_sketches' images as subtle background layers or visual breaks between text-heavy sections to satisfy the 'more artistic Fort art' requirement.
Incorporate the Burnt Orange (#E87524) carefully - use it for CTAs, map markers, and highlighting key statistics or pull quotes.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that have content under them. Always use a blur or a solid color.
Use Leaflet (react-leaflet) for the interactive map. Style the map to look clean, possibly using a muted or grayscale map tile layer to let the Burnt Orange markers pop.
Ensure the Admin dashboard feels distinctly functional (dense, charcoal/white) compared to the public-facing editorial pages.
Do NOT center-align paragraphs. Left-align for editorial readability.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, links, and major components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles, specifically sharp rectangular buttons for this editorial design.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All .js files should follow these guidelines (avoid .tsx as the project uses .js).
